**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech-led: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +32.93%) showing strength. Consumer Staples ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +3.42%) and Consumer Discretionary ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.44% | 1M: +2.17%) are steady while Energy (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%)) and Utilities (XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -3.55%)) show weakness.

**5. US vs Global?**

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation active: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +12.32%), ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +10.76%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +8.37%) signal risk-on positioning within a limited leadership set.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Copper/industrial metals firm: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +5.96%). Precious metals mixed: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.89% | 1M: -0.66%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +6.12%), while Brent (BNO CORRECTION (1W: -8.30% | 1M: +11.77%)) shows weekly profit-taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -8.30% | 1M: +11.77%) highlight short-term selling versus longer-run gains; natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -3.61%) remains subdued.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Tech (XLK, QQQ, SOXX) and broad large-cap risk (SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +8.22%)) show conviction. Divergence: breadth only 3/11 and multiple 1W/1M mismatches (XLF CORRECTION (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +0.86%) and TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -1.10%); HYG CORRECTION) constitute MAJOR Divergence signals that suppress high-conviction regime calls.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor tech/quality exposure given XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) while reducing exposure to Energy (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%)) and defensive sleeves showing weakness; bonds neutral with TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -1.10%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) / SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +32.93%) if momentum broadens. BEARISH: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -3.62%) / XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -3.55%) if weakness continues.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +5.96%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +6.12%) on industrial and precious metals demand. BEARISH: BNO CORRECTION (1W: -8.30% | 1M: +11.77%) and UGA CORRECTION (1W: -3.65% | 1M: +18.78%) on near-term crude retracement.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -11.88%) — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.11%) / LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -0.30%) — watch HYG/LQD spread as credit barometer. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%) vs XLF CORRECTION (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +0.86%) — watch XLK/XLF gap for style rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, with narrow, tech-led advance (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +19.76%)) but limited participation. Key risk is MAJOR divergence between strong tech and weak breadth/credit signals (XLF CORRECTION (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +0.86%), HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.11%)).
